title: IP UDP source-copy fault may publish a malformed datagram
mechanism: BoundDatagram::try_send asks aster-bigtcp UdpSocket::send to reserve a full-size smoltcp send slot and copies the user payload into it afterwards. A copy fault returns EFAULT but leaves the reserved slot queued for the next interface poll.
contract: A UDP send whose source copy faults fails with EFAULT and publishes no datagram (sendmsg(2), Linux udp_sendmsg).
observed: Source only: the syscall returns EFAULT while a full-size datagram slot with an unwritten tail remains queued for transmission.

repro.how_to_run: No reproducer. finding.md Reproduction describes the proposed loopback UDP check with a payload straddling a PROT_NONE page.

caveats: Source-only lead: peer-visible outcome not reproduced. Tail contents of the queued slot not established. Same FIXME present at upstream main bc12195 (package-builder check).
